shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on a boulder-like monolith
horizontal bands/registers of repeated block-like motifs
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, rounded low-relief motifs organised into horizontal bands of repeated block-like or scroll-like units, and both include circular/disc elements set within those bands. The decisive difference is that B is an explicitly anthropomorphic figure with a sculpted head, face and torso whose ornament is arranged as a headdress, chest disc and belt on a body, whereas A shows no figure at all, only registers of glyph-like relief spread over an undifferentiated boulder.
